rules.claim: ANGLE Vulkan now propagates explicit deferred memory-barrier bits through storage buffer/image access helpers. conditions.scope: selected source diff, no universal device inference

rules.recommendation: Add a candidate multi-resource rebind regression; preserve API consumer-specific barrier semantics. Do not promote a new mandatory global-barrier rule or infer a speedup.
